title: 1  Performance Measures
text:
1.1.1 Exercise
Consider two generic prediction models {f_1} and {f_2} for univariate, continuous outcome with multivariate predictors . Without knowing anything about how the prediction models were created, describe how you might evaluate the performance of and if you know the true relationship between and . Try to be precise in your description, using mathematical notation if helpful.
